name: my-workbench-lanes-ui
description: MyWorkbench lane settings page, packaged as a profile-layer DSH client plugin: it edits the settings namespace the MyWorkbench preset's lane host half owns. The version names the my-workbench release that rendered the installed copy: `my-workbench --dsh` writes its own version over this field, and the release gate fails if the two differ. The browser half carries the same version in its header comment, because a client package has no manifest field the shell reads.
